The change swaps the exception type that escapes the ZipFile/JarFile constructor for a malformed central directory: IllegalArgumentException (unchecked) becomes ZipException (checked IOException). The noreg-cleanup label only says no regression test was written. Under the given vocabulary a visible exception-type change belongs in candidate-measured (run the zip malformed-file tests on the adapted build and confirm the thrown type) unless the diff shows the IAE was already caught and wrapped inside initCEN, in which case candidate-adapted stands.
